request.style: English, male rock voice, electric guitar, bass, drums, keyboard, urgent and hopeful mood, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In your righteousness, deliver me
Turn your ear to me, come quick
Be my rock of refuge now
A fortress that saves my life

[Pre-Chorus]
You are my rock and stronghold
Lead me for the sake of your name

[Chorus]
Into your hand I commit my spirit
You have redeemed me, Lord
God of truth, I trust in you
Into your hand I commit my spirit

[Verse]
Free me from the net they hid
For you are my refuge today
I hate worthless idols' cling
I put my trust in the Lord

[Chorus]
Into your hand I commit my spirit
You have redeemed me, Lord
God of truth, I trust in you
Into your hand I commit my spirit

[Bridge]
You have seen my deep affliction
Known the distress of my soul
Not handed over to the enemy
You have set my feet free

[Chorus]
Into your hand I commit my spirit
You have redeemed me, Lord
God of truth, I trust in you
Into your hand I commit my spirit

[Outro]
You have set my feet in freedom
I will rejoice in your mercy
